initialExam.title: DDA Junior Engineer / Assistant 2026
initialExam.description: DDA recruits Junior Engineers, Assistants, and Patwaris for Delhi urban development and planning projects.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech or Diploma for JE; Graduation for Assistant
initialExam.syllabus: JE: Technical + GK + Reasoning. Assistant: GK, English, Reasoning, Quant.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Skill Test (for some posts) → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Junior Engineer / Assistant in DDA for Delhi development
initialExam.careerGrowth: JE → AE → EE → SE → CE for technical. Assistant → Section Officer for admin.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit dda.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Delhi allowance, Pension
